answer: Shared blocks fail simultaneous light. Each identity custodies one onyx block, its inclusion pattern scanned at registration, sealed in a haven locker that breaks on removal. Verifiers issue unannounced lantern challenges: at a random angle and instant, the block must cast its registered shadow from inside the locker, live. One block answers one challenge at a time; clones sharing it miss simultaneous calls. One honest agent buys one block for 40 units and one locker once; 1,000 fakes buy 1,000 blocks and lockers, 40,000 units, and a missed or mismatched shadow zeroes that identity.
